title_sq: Tek Rezidenca Platinium, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!
description_sq: Tek Rezidenca Platinium, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 1 banim, si dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto prej 125.7 m2, nga ku siperfaqja neto eshte 108.9 m2. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe ballkoni qe rrethon te gjithe apartamentin. Orientimi i prones eshte Perendim. title_en: At Rezidenca Platinium, Super Apartment 2+1+2, with regular layout, for sale!
description_en: At Rezidenca Platinium, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, with a regular floor plan!!! The property is located on the 1st residential floor, and has a gross area of ​​125.7 m2, from which the net area is 108.9 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony that surrounds the entire apartment. The orientation of the property is West. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life. It also has a parking post with an extra value of 25,000 euros.
